answer_1.quote: To evaluate the performance of each Tied-LoRA configuration across diverse data settings, we utilized the following types of tasks: ... Summarization ... Translation ... Mathematical Reasoning ... We use greedy-decoding to generate the models' predictions with a limit of 500 tokens.
